name: ledger
description: A durable, id'd record of a thread's work in SQLite: workloads opened and closed with a reason, questions to the human with one-word answers, approvals, decisions, cost ceilings. A CLI the agent runs, batch pastes applied line by line, and hooks that deny pushes, PR creation and out-of-folder writes until a workload is open, refuse a turn that asks a question with no row, and park open work at session end. Every hook fails open.
